patch_description:
Replace the exponentially weighted moving average with a causal robust local-linear estimator followed by a lightweight alpha-beta trend tracker with reversal hysteresis.

The local-linear fit predicts at the newest sample in each window, removing the inherent trailing-average delay while retaining sliding-window noise suppression. Median/MAD clipping limits the influence of impulsive samples and non-stationary outliers. The adaptive tracker uses local slope evidence to increase gain during genuine directional motion and lower gain during noise-dominated flat periods. Finally, a noise-scaled hysteresis band suppresses small opposite-direction updates, directly reducing false reversals and slope-change count without blocking substantial real trend reversals.
